subject: Post-demo follow-up: procurement path & mutual action plan (Acme Cloud)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: procurement path & mutual action plan (Acme Cloud)

Thanks again for the demo this morning, Daniel — really appreciated the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can unblock procurement on your side.

Recap (from our call)
- Acme Cloud wants to run Redwood in a Dedicated/reserved capacity for initial pilot (privacy + latency).
- Key internal stakeholders: Security (Priya Shah), Legal (Daniel K.), Finance (Dan’s procurement team).
- Primary commercial question: PO vs. card vs. marketplace procurement path.

Proposed mutual action plan & timeline (high level)
1) Contract review (Legal) — Estimated 7–10 business days for first pass
2) Security evidence & questionnaire (Security) — we'll provide SOC2 summary + questionnaire answers (2–5 business days; can be parallel with legal)
3) Finance review & PO setup (Finance) — once contract terms agreed, PO issuance (3–7 business days)
4) Kickoff and provisioning — we can reserve Dedicated capacity once PO signed or marketplace order completed

Attachments: Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf (initial SOW), SOC2-summary.pdf (controls summary). I’ve also linked the HubSpot deal below for your finance team.

Next asks / owners
- Daniel: confirm preferred commercial path (PO + standard Redwood MSA / SOW vs. AWS Marketplace purchase). If PO, confirm who in finance we should engage and any PO templates.
- Priya: we'll send SOC2 + short answers now; let us know if you need a completed security questionnaire.
- Marcus (cc): I’ll loop you in for any technical clarifications during the security review.

Target dates (flexible)
- Legal first pass: target 2026-03-17
- Security Qs completed: target 2026-03-12
- PO expected: target week of 2026-03-22

If you’d like we can do a 20-minute procurement checklist call next week to align owners and confirm the PO flow.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: procurement path & mutual action plan (Acme Cloud)

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Preferred path: Finance prefers to purchase via PO (company policy for new vendors). We do have an AWS Marketplace option but that requires additional procurement approvals and usage metering we'd rather avoid for the pilot.
- Legal: I’ll share your SOW with our Legal team (Amy Patel). Expect a first-pass redline in ~7–12 business days depending on their queue.
- Security: Priya’s team will start with the SOC2 summary and our standard security questionnaire. If you can provide the questionnaire answers, that speeds things up — Priya will confirm the specific doc.
- Finance / PO: Our procurement contact is Carla Gomez (carla.gomez@acmecloud.com). I’ll introduce you to Carla once Amy confirms the contract route. Carla will confirm any PO template needs.

Timeline outlook: Legal review (w/ first-pass redline) by ~2026-03-20; Security Qs completed by ~2026-03-12; PO issuance target week of 2026-03-22 as you noted.

We’re aligned on the mutual action plan. Yes to a short procurement checklist call — can you do Wed 3/11 at 11:00am PT?

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Cloud Platform — Acme Cloud
